# Catalogue of aggregate tables {#sec-table-catalogue}

```{r}
source("R/book.R")
```

The aggregate tables are in three folders. These lists are generated from the
index file (`README_outputs.csv`) that the pipeline writes into each folder.
An asterisk in a file name stands for several files: `set2_static_by_*.csv`
is one file for each characteristic. @sec-aggregate-tables explains how to
use them.

## Mileage tables: `tables/mileage/`

Details: [Vehicles and mileage by postcode area](../reports/mileage_report.md).

```{r}
m <- read_pipeline("outputs", "tables", "mileage", "README_outputs.csv")
m$file <- paste0("`", m$file, "`")
kable(m, col.names = c("File", "One row per", "Contents"))
```

## Fleet profile tables: `tables/profile/`

Details: [Fleet profile tables](../reports/fleet_profile_report.md).

```{r}
p <- read_pipeline("outputs", "tables", "profile", "README_outputs.csv")
p$file <- paste0("`", p$file, "`")
kable(p, col.names = c("File", "Form", "Contents"))
```

## Churn tables: `tables/churn/`

Details: [Churn tables](../reports/churn_tables_report.md).

```{r}
ch <- read_pipeline("outputs", "tables", "churn", "README_outputs.csv")
ch$file <- paste0("`", ch$file, "`")
kable(ch, col.names = c("File", "Set", "Contents"))
```
